            SELECT tp.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tp.period_date,
                   ti.surname, ti.firstname, ti.middlename, ti.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tp.pag_ibig_ps, tp.pag_ibig_ln, tp.pag_ibig_hs, tp.pag_ibig_calamity, tp.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tp.mcempc_ln, tp.mcempc_share, tp.cfi, tp.CT_HOUSING, tp.OTHER_PAYABLE, tp.sss_pm,
                   (tp.pag_ibig_ps + tp.pag_ibig_ln + tp.pag_ibig_hs + tp.pag_ibig_calamity + tp.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tp.mcempc_ln + tp.mcempc_share + tp.CT_HOUSING + tp.sss_pm + tp.OTHER_PAYABLE + tp.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tp.isPassed
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tp
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tp.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tp.TID = tpp.TID
            LEFT JOIN tblpersonalinformation ti ON tp.PIID = ti.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tp.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tp.period_date >= ? AND tp.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tp.pag_ibig_ps + tp.pag_ibig_ln + tp.pag_ibig_hs + tp.pag_ibig_calamity + tp.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tp.mcempc_ln + tp.mcempc_share + tp.CT_HOUSING + tp.sss_pm + tp.OTHER_PAYABLE + tp.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tp.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tp.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tp.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tp.piid, ti.surname, ti.firstname, ti.middlename, ti.nameext, tp.period_date
                      ORDER BY dept ASC, ti.surname ASC, ti.firstname ASC, tp.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date
                      ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +

                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (

                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(

                        '1-%'

            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID

                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',

                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date

                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1

                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'

                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (

                        '1-%'

                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date ) as sub

            SELECT tpf.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tpf.period_date,
                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date
                      ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date = ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date

                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date ) as sub

            SELECT tpf.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tpf.period_date,
                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date = ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date
                      ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date = ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +

                    WHERE

            SELECT tpf.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tpf.period_date,
                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date
                      ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

            SELECT tpf.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tpf.period_date,
                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1

            SELECT tpf.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tpf.period_date,
                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date
                      ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

            SELECT tpf.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tpf.period_date,
                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date = ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date
                      ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

            SELECT tpf.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tpf.period_date,
                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID

                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf

            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date = ? AND days_present <> '0.00'

                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date = ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +

                AND EXISTS (

                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(

                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date

            SELECT tpf.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tpf.period_date,
                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.PAGIBIG_Number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date = ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date
                      ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)

            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID

                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf

                               LIMIT 1

                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID

                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID

                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND t2.period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               LIMIT 1
                           )) AS pagibig_number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND t3.period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               LIMIT 1
                           )) AS sss_number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +

                AND ispassed = 0
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM inc_payroll_locking l
                    WHERE
                      l.`Payroll_Number` LIKE CONCAT(
                        'PSYS',
                        DATE_FORMAT(tpf.`period_date`, '%Y%m'),
                        tpf.`TID`,
                        '1-%'
                      )
                      AND l.`isdeleted` = 0
                      AND l.`islock` = 1
                ) AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tpp.Name, tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext, tpf.period_date, ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number, tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp, tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm, tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID

                SELECT /*+ FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) */ tr.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tr.period_date,
                        tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                        ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number,
                        tr.all_ibig AS pag_ibig_ps, 0 AS pag_ibig_ln, 0 AS pag_ibig_hs, 0 AS pag_ibig_calamity, 0 AS pag_ibig_mp,
                        tr.MCEMPC_LN, tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0 AS cfi, tr.CT_HOUSING, tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, tr.SSS_PM AS sss_pm,
                        (tr.all_ibig + tr.MCEMPC_LN + tr.MCEMPC_SHARE + tr.CT_HOUSING + tr.SSS_PM + tr.OTHER_PAYABLE) AS total_deduct,
                        1 AS isPassed, tr.groupid AS TID
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT pn.PIID,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT PAG_IBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND t2.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t2.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t2.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS pagibig_number,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND t3.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t3.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t3.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS sss_number
                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                    ) ln ON tr.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tr.remittance_id = ? AND (tr.all_ibig <> 0 OR tr.SSS_PM <> 0 OR tr.OTHER_PAYABLE <> 0 OR tr.CT_HOUSING <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_LN <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_SHARE <> 0)
                ORDER BY tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                SELECT /*+ FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) */ tr.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tr.period_date,
                        tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                        ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number,
                        tr.all_ibig AS pag_ibig_ps, 0 AS pag_ibig_ln, 0 AS pag_ibig_hs, 0 AS pag_ibig_calamity, 0 AS pag_ibig_mp,
                        tr.MCEMPC_LN, tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0 AS cfi, tr.CT_HOUSING, tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, tr.SSS_PM AS sss_pm,
                        (tr.all_ibig + tr.MCEMPC_LN + tr.MCEMPC_SHARE + tr.CT_HOUSING + tr.SSS_PM + tr.OTHER_PAYABLE) AS total_deduct,
                        1 AS isPassed, tr.groupid AS TID
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT pn.PIID,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT PAG_IBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND t2.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t2.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t2.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS pagibig_number,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND t3.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t3.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t3.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS sss_number
                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                    ) ln ON tr.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tr.remittance_id = ? AND (tr.all_ibig <> 0 OR tr.SSS_PM <> 0 OR tr.OTHER_PAYABLE <> 0 OR tr.CT_HOUSING <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_LN <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_SHARE <> 0)

                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID

                               AND t2.period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               LIMIT 1
                           )) AS pagibig_number,

                               LIMIT 1

                SELECT /*+ FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) */ tr.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tr.period_date,
                        tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                        ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number,
                        tr.PAG_IBIG_PS, tr.PAG_IBIG_LN, tr.PAG_IBIG_HS, tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY, tr.PAG_IBIG_MP,
                        tr.MCEMPC_LN, tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, tr.CFI, tr.CT_HOUSING, tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, tr.SSS_PM,
                        (tr.PAG_IBIG_PS + tr.PAG_IBIG_LN + tr.PAG_IBIG_HS + tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY + tr.PAG_IBIG_MP +
                         tr.MCEMPC_LN + tr.MCEMPC_SHARE + tr.CT_HOUSING + tr.SSS_PM + tr.OTHER_PAYABLE + tr.CFI) AS total_deduct,
                        1 AS isPassed, tr.groupid AS TID
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT pn.PIID,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT PAG_IBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND t2.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t2.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t2.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS pagibig_number,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND t3.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t3.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t3.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS sss_number
                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                    ) ln ON tr.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tr.remittance_id = ? AND (tr.all_ibig <> 0 OR tr.SSS_PM <> 0 OR tr.OTHER_PAYABLE <> 0 OR tr.CT_HOUSING <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_LN <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_SHARE <> 0)
                ORDER BY tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                        tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                        ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number,
                        tr.PAG_IBIG_PS, tr.PAG_IBIG_LN, tr.PAG_IBIG_HS, tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY, tr.PAG_IBIG_MP,
                        tr.MCEMPC_LN, tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, tr.CFI, tr.CT_HOUSING, tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, tr.SSS_PM,
                        (tr.PAG_IBIG_PS + tr.PAG_IBIG_LN + tr.PAG_IBIG_HS + tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY + tr.PAG_IBIG_MP +
                         tr.MCEMPC_LN + tr.MCEMPC_SHARE + tr.CT_HOUSING + tr.SSS_PM + tr.OTHER_PAYABLE + tr.CFI) AS total_deduct,
                        1 AS isPassed, tr.groupid AS TID
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT pn.PIID,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT PAG_IBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND t2.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t2.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t2.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS pagibig_number,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND t3.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t3.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t3.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS sss_number
                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                    ) ln ON tr.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tr.remittance_id = ? AND (tr.all_ibig <> 0 OR tr.SSS_PM <> 0 OR tr.OTHER_PAYABLE <> 0 OR tr.CT_HOUSING <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_LN <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_SHARE <> 0)

                   tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                   ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number,
                   tpf.pag_ibig_ps, tpf.pag_ibig_ln, tpf.pag_ibig_hs, tpf.pag_ibig_calamity, tpf.pag_ibig_mp,
                   tpf.mcempc_ln, tpf.mcempc_share, tpf.cfi, tpf.CT_HOUSING, tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE, tpf.sss_pm,
                   (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                    tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) AS total_deduct,
                   tpf.isPassed, tpf.TID
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT pn.PIID,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.PAG_IBIG_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND t2.period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               LIMIT 1
                           )) AS pagibig_number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND t3.period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               LIMIT 1
                           )) AS sss_number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'

                SELECT /*+ FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) */ tr.piid, tpp.Name AS dept, tr.period_date,
                        tp.surname, tp.firstname, tp.middlename, tp.nameext,
                        ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number,
                        tr.PAG_IBIG_PS, tr.PAG_IBIG_LN, tr.PAG_IBIG_HS, tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY, tr.PAG_IBIG_MP,
                        tr.MCEMPC_LN, tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, tr.CFI, tr.CT_HOUSING, tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, tr.SSS_PM,
                        (tr.PAG_IBIG_PS + tr.PAG_IBIG_LN + tr.PAG_IBIG_HS + tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY + tr.PAG_IBIG_MP +
                         tr.MCEMPC_LN + tr.MCEMPC_SHARE + tr.CT_HOUSING + tr.SSS_PM + tr.OTHER_PAYABLE + tr.CFI) AS total_deduct,
                        1 AS isPassed, tr.groupid AS TID
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT pn.PIID,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT PAG_IBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND t2.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t2.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t2.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS pagibig_number,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND t3.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t3.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t3.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS sss_number
                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                    ) ln ON tr.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tr.remittance_id = ? AND (tr.all_ibig <> 0 OR tr.SSS_PM <> 0 OR tr.OTHER_PAYABLE <> 0 OR tr.CT_HOUSING <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_LN <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_SHARE <> 0)
                ORDER BY tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                               WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t2.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS PAGIBIG_Number,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(pn.SSS_Number, ''), (
                               SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                               WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                               AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                               AND period_date = (SELECT MAX(period_date) FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE PIID = t3.PIID)
                               ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                           )) AS SSS_Number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                ) ln ON tpf.PIID = ln.PIID
            WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
            AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                 tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
            AND ispassed = 0
             AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3) 
             GROUP BY tpf.piid, tpf.period_date ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC

                        ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number,

                        COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_LN, 0) as MCEMPC_LN, COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0) as MCEMPC_SHARE, COALESCE(tr.CFI, 0) as CFI, COALESCE(tr.CT_HOUSING, 0) as CT_HOUSING, COALESCE(tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, 0) as OTHER_PAYABLE, COALESCE(tr.SSS_PM, 0) as SSS_PM,
                        (COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_PS, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_LN, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_HS, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_MP, 0) +
                         COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_LN, 0) + COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0) + COALESCE(tr.CT_HOUSING, 0) + COALESCE(tr.SSS_PM, 0) + COALESCE(tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, 0) + COALESCE(tr.CFI, 0)) AS total_deduct,
                        1 AS isPassed, tr.groupid AS TID
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT pn.PIID,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT PAG_IBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND t2.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t2.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t2.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS pagibig_number,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND t3.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t3.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t3.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS sss_number
                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                    ) ln ON tr.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tr.remittance_id = ? AND (tr.all_ibig <> 0 OR tr.SSS_PM <> 0 OR tr.OTHER_PAYABLE <> 0 OR tr.CT_HOUSING <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_LN <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_SHARE <> 0)
