                        ln.pagibig_number, ln.sss_number,
                        COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_PS, 0) as pag_ibig_ps, COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_LN, 0) as pag_ibig_ln, COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_HS, 0) as pag_ibig_hs, COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY, 0) as pag_ibig_calamity, COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_MP, 0) as pag_ibig_mp,
                        COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_LN, 0) as mcempc_ln, COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0) as mcempc_share, COALESCE(tr.CFI, 0) as cfi, COALESCE(tr.CT_HOUSING, 0) as CT_HOUSING, COALESCE(tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, 0) as OTHER_PAYABLE, COALESCE(tr.SSS_PM, 0) as sss_pm,
                        (COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_PS, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_LN, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_HS, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_MP, 0) +
                         COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_LN, 0) + COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0) + COALESCE(tr.CT_HOUSING, 0) + COALESCE(tr.SSS_PM, 0) + COALESCE(tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, 0) + COALESCE(tr.CFI, 0)) AS total_deduct,
                        1 AS isPassed, tr.groupid AS TID
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT pn.PIID,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT PAG_IBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND t2.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t2.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT PAGIBIG_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t2
                                     WHERE t2.PIID = pn.PIID AND t2.PAGIBIG_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t2.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t2.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS pagibig_number,
                                COALESCE((
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND t3.isdeleted=0
                                     ORDER BY t3.Date_Added DESC LIMIT 1
                                 ), (
                                     SELECT SSS_Number FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t3
                                     WHERE t3.PIID = pn.PIID AND t3.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL
                                     AND t3.quencina IN (1, 3)
                                     ORDER BY t3.period_date DESC LIMIT 1
                                 )) AS sss_number
                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo pn WHERE isdeleted=0 GROUP BY pn.PIID
                    ) ln ON tr.PIID = ln.PIID
                WHERE tr.remittance_id = ? AND (tr.all_ibig <> 0 OR tr.SSS_PM <> 0 OR tr.OTHER_PAYABLE <> 0 OR tr.CT_HOUSING <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_LN <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_SHARE <> 0)
                ORDER BY tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                         COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_LN, 0) + COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0) + COALESCE(tr.CT_HOUSING, 0) + COALESCE(tr.SSS_PM, 0) + COALESCE(tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, 0) + COALESCE(tr.CFI, 0)) AS total_deduct,

                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo numbers ON tr.PIID = numbers.PIID AND numbers.isdeleted = 0
                LEFT JOIN (

                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo latest
                    INNER JOIN (

                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo 
                        WHERE (pagibig_number IS NOT NULL AND pagibig_number <> '' OR sss_number IS NOT NULL AND sss_number <> '')
                        GROUP BY PIID
                    ) latest_max ON latest.PIID = latest_max.PIID AND latest.period_date = latest_max.latest_date

            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf

                   MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_ps) as pag_ibig_ps, MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_ln) as pag_ibig_ln, MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_hs) as pag_ibig_hs, MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_calamity) as pag_ibig_calamity, MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_mp) as pag_ibig_mp,
                   MIN(tpf.mcempc_ln) as mcempc_ln, MIN(tpf.mcempc_share) as mcempc_share, MIN(tpf.cfi) as cfi, MIN(tpf.CT_HOUSING) as CT_HOUSING, MIN(tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE) as OTHER_PAYABLE, MIN(tpf.sss_pm) as sss_pm,
                   (MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_ps) + MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_ln) + MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_hs) + MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_calamity) + MIN(tpf.pag_ibig_mp) +
                    MIN(tpf.mcempc_ln) + MIN(tpf.mcempc_share) + MIN(tpf.CT_HOUSING) + MIN(tpf.sss_pm) + MIN(tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE) + MIN(tpf.cfi)) AS total_deduct,
                   MIN(tpf.isPassed) as isPassed, MIN(tpf.TID) as TID,
                   MIN(tpp.Name) AS dept,
                   COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN latest_numbers.pagibig_number IS NOT NULL AND latest_numbers.pagibig_number <> '' 
                                     AND latest_numbers.pagibig_number NOT LIKE '%OVER%' 
                                     AND latest_numbers.pagibig_number NOT LIKE '%COUNTER%' 
                                     AND latest_numbers.pagibig_number NOT LIKE '%NULL%'
                                     AND latest_numbers.pagibig_number NOT LIKE '%N/A%'
                                     THEN latest_numbers.pagibig_number END),
                             MAX(CASE WHEN numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number <> '' 
                                     AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number NOT LIKE '%OVER%' 
                                     AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number NOT LIKE '%COUNTER%'
                                     AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number NOT LIKE '%NULL%'
                                     AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number NOT LIKE '%N/A%'
                                     THEN numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number END), '') as pagibig_number,
                   COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN latest_numbers.sss_number IS NOT NULL AND latest_numbers.sss_number <> '' 
                                    AND latest_numbers.sss_number NOT LIKE '%OVER%' 
                                    AND latest_numbers.sss_number NOT LIKE '%COUNTER%' 
                                    AND latest_numbers.sss_number NOT LIKE '%NULL%'
                                    AND latest_numbers.sss_number NOT LIKE '%N/A%'
                                    THEN latest_numbers.sss_number END),
                            MAX(CASE WHEN numbers.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND numbers.SSS_Number <> '' 
                                    AND numbers.SSS_Number NOT LIKE '%OVER%' 
                                    AND numbers.SSS_Number NOT LIKE '%COUNTER%'
                                    AND numbers.SSS_Number NOT LIKE '%NULL%'
                                    AND numbers.SSS_Number NOT LIKE '%N/A%'
                                    THEN numbers.SSS_Number END), '') as sss_number
            FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo tpf
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tj ON tpf.PIID = tj.PIID
            INNER JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp ON tpf.TID = tpp.TID
            INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp ON tpf.PIID = tp.PIID
            LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo numbers ON tpf.PIID = numbers.PIID AND numbers.isdeleted = 0
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT t.PIID, t.pagibig_number, t.sss_number
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo t
                INNER JOIN (
                    SELECT PIID, MAX(period_date) as max_date
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo 
                    WHERE PIID IN (SELECT DISTINCT PIID FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo WHERE period_date >= ? AND period_date <= ?)
                    AND (pagibig_number IS NOT NULL AND pagibig_number <> '')
                    GROUP BY PIID
                ) max_dates ON t.PIID = max_dates.PIID AND t.period_date = max_dates.max_date
            ) latest_numbers ON tpf.PIID = latest_numbers.PIID
                WHERE tpf.period_date >= ? AND tpf.period_date <= ? AND days_present <> '0.00'
                AND (tpf.pag_ibig_ps + tpf.pag_ibig_ln + tpf.pag_ibig_hs + tpf.pag_ibig_calamity + tpf.pag_ibig_mp +
                     tpf.mcempc_ln + tpf.mcempc_share + tpf.CT_HOUSING + tpf.sss_pm + tpf.OTHER_PAYABLE + tpf.cfi) <> 0
                AND ispassed = 0
                AND tpf.isDeleted = 0 AND tpf.quencina IN (1, 3)  GROUP BY tpf.piid, tpf.period_date ORDER BY dept ASC, tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC, tpf.period_date ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

                        COALESCE(CASE WHEN latest_payroll.pagibig_number IS NOT NULL AND latest_payroll.pagibig_number <> '' 
                                      AND latest_payroll.pagibig_number NOT LIKE '%OVER%' 
                                      AND latest_payroll.pagibig_number NOT LIKE '%COUNTER%' 
                                      AND latest_payroll.pagibig_number NOT LIKE '%NULL%'
                                      AND latest_payroll.pagibig_number NOT LIKE '%N/A%'
                                      THEN latest_payroll.pagibig_number
                                      WHEN numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number IS NOT NULL AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number <> '' 
                                      AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number NOT LIKE '%OVER%' 
                                      AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number NOT LIKE '%COUNTER%'
                                      AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number NOT LIKE '%NULL%'
                                      AND numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number NOT LIKE '%N/A%'
                                      THEN numbers.PAG_IBIG_Number
                                      ELSE '' END, '') as pagibig_number,
                        COALESCE(CASE WHEN latest_payroll.sss_number IS NOT NULL AND latest_payroll.sss_number <> '' 
                                      AND latest_payroll.sss_number NOT LIKE '%OVER%' 
                                      AND latest_payroll.sss_number NOT LIKE '%COUNTER%' 
                                      AND latest_payroll.sss_number NOT LIKE '%NULL%'
                                      AND latest_payroll.sss_number NOT LIKE '%N/A%'
                                      THEN latest_payroll.sss_number
                                      WHEN numbers.SSS_Number IS NOT NULL AND numbers.SSS_Number <> '' 
                                      AND numbers.SSS_Number NOT LIKE '%OVER%' 
                                      AND numbers.SSS_Number NOT LIKE '%COUNTER%'
                                      AND numbers.SSS_Number NOT LIKE '%NULL%'
                                      AND numbers.SSS_Number NOT LIKE '%N/A%'
                                      THEN numbers.SSS_Number
                                      ELSE '' END, '') as sss_number,
                        COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_PS, 0) as pag_ibig_ps, COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_LN, 0) as pag_ibig_ln, COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_HS, 0) as pag_ibig_hs, COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY, 0) as pag_ibig_calamity, COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_MP, 0) as pag_ibig_mp,
                        COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_LN, 0) as mcempc_ln, COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0) as mcempc_share, COALESCE(tr.CFI, 0) as cfi, COALESCE(tr.CT_HOUSING, 0) as CT_HOUSING, COALESCE(tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, 0) as OTHER_PAYABLE, COALESCE(tr.SSS_PM, 0) as sss_pm,
                        (COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_PS, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_LN, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_HS, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_CALAMITY, 0) + COALESCE(tr.PAG_IBIG_MP, 0) +
                         COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_LN, 0) + COALESCE(tr.MCEMPC_SHARE, 0) + COALESCE(tr.CT_HOUSING, 0) + COALESCE(tr.SSS_PM, 0) + COALESCE(tr.OTHER_PAYABLE, 0) + COALESCE(tr.CFI, 0)) AS total_deduct,
                        1 AS isPassed, tr.groupid AS TID
                FROM tbl_syl_payroll_remittance_jo tr
                FORCE INDEX (idx_remittance_id)
                INNER JOIN tblpersonalinformation tp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.PIID = tp.PIID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_templatepayroll_jo tpp FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON tr.groupid = tpp.TID
                LEFT JOIN tbl_syl_payroll_numbers_jo numbers ON tr.PIID = numbers.PIID AND numbers.isdeleted = 0
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT latest.PIID, latest.pagibig_number, latest.sss_number
                    FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo latest
                    INNER JOIN (
                        SELECT PIID, MAX(period_date) as latest_date
                        FROM tbl_syl_payroll_for_print_jo 
                        WHERE (pagibig_number IS NOT NULL AND pagibig_number <> '' OR sss_number IS NOT NULL AND sss_number <> '')
                        GROUP BY PIID
                    ) latest_max ON latest.PIID = latest_max.PIID AND latest.period_date = latest_max.latest_date
                ) latest_payroll ON tr.PIID = latest_payroll.PIID
                WHERE tr.remittance_id = ? AND (tr.all_ibig <> 0 OR tr.SSS_PM <> 0 OR tr.OTHER_PAYABLE <> 0 OR tr.CT_HOUSING <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_LN <> 0 OR tr.MCEMPC_SHARE <> 0)
                ORDER BY tp.surname ASC, tp.firstname ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0
